summary_1line: Narada describes realms of bird dynasties, the cow Surabhi in Rasatala, and the serpent city Bhogavati ruled by the Naga king Vasuki.

image_candidates.scene_text: The celestial cow Surabhi stands in the depths of Rasatala as a stream of her milk forms the vast white Milky Ocean ringed with foam.
The great serpent Shesha with a thousand flaming tongues and jewel-studded hoods supports the entire Earth upon his immense white body.
The radiant serpent city Bhogavati shines like Amaravati while countless multi‑headed Nagas adorned with gems coil around its palaces.
